history.claim: Chak Phra is also known as Lak Phra. Its roots come from the belief in welcoming the Buddha back from the Tavatimsa heaven.
history.quote: Chak Phra tradition, or another name Lak Phra tradition

history.claim: In Khura Buri District of Phang Nga, this tradition has been passed down for a long time, featuring the pulling of the Buddha boat from communities to join the celebration.
history.quote: People in each subdistrict help pull the Buddha boat from their own communities.

history.claim: It is not verified when it started or who started it, nor its specific role during the tin mining era, Sino-Portuguese architecture, or heritage registration, as the tradition is a ritual activity, not a historical building.

timeline.title: Contemporary evidence in Phang Nga but held in Khura Buri
timeline.detail: News reports the pulling of the Buddha boat from communities to join the celebration and contest in Khura Buri District, not evidence of it being held in Takua Pa.

timeline.title: Ritual pattern after Buddhist Lent
timeline.detail: Locals invite the Buddha image onto the Phanom Phra or Buddha boat, then pull it in a procession by land or water depending on the terrain.

news.title: Preserving the Chak Phra Tradition 2023 (2566)
news.summary: News reported the event in Khura Buri District, Phang Nga, featuring the pulling of the Buddha boat from communities and a celebration. This is used as comparative data, not Takua Pa news.

visit.best_time: The 1st waning moon day of the 11th lunar month or the day after the end of Buddhist Lent. However, the actual date may change according to local announcements.

history.claim: The Buddha's relics are enshrined at Wat Boromthat Khiri Khet, and a relic stupa was built on Khao Phra Phutthabat to house them.
history.quote: A relic stupa was built on Khao Phra Phutthabat

history.claim: The Buddha's relics procession is an annual tradition held on Makha Bucha Day.
history.quote: There is an annual Buddha's relics procession tradition on Makha Bucha Day

history.claim: Wat Boromthat Khiri Khet is locally known as Wat Lum, and an ancient stupa base is its key element.
history.quote: Locals often call it Wat Lum

timeline.title: Official establishment of Wat Khiri Khet
timeline.detail: Academic documents citing the Fine Arts Department state that Takua Pa's first temple was built on this day.

timeline.title: Granted Royal Wisungkhammasima
timeline.detail: The temple evolved from a monk's residence into a temple with a stable status in the community.

timeline.title: Makha Bucha Day and royal chariot procession around the old town
timeline.detail: The procession takes the Buddha's relics from the vihara, parades around the town, and enshrines them in the stupa the next day.

timeline.title: The Buddha's relics procession to Khao Phra Phutthabat
timeline.detail: A celebration is held, parading through the old town, and enshrined at the relic stupa on Khao Phra Phutthabat.

news.title: Phang Nga holds a grand Makha Bucha event to pay respect to the Buddha's relics
news.summary: Promoted the event on 11 to 12 February 2025 (2568) at Wat Boromthat Khiri Khet and the procession activity.

news.title: Makha Bucha Day 2025 paying respect to the Buddha's relics in Takua Pa
news.summary: Reported the schedule for the royal chariot procession around the old town and the enshrining of the Buddha's relics into the stupa.

visit.best_time: Makha Bucha Day, which is the annual tradition period, but the date on the solar calendar changes every year.
visit.dress_code: Dress politely and follow temple customs.

relic-procession.address_line: Klan Kaeo Road, around Takua Pa old town

history.claim: A promotional video by Takua Pa Town Municipality published on 1 September 2024 (2567) recommended Lan Long Market as a hub for various foods. This evidence confirms the promotion in that year, not the market's founding year.
history.quote: There is rice with curry, made-to-order dishes, noodles, and Kanom Jeen

history.claim: News on 19 June 2025 (2568) mentioned a guideline to develop Lan Long Market into a modern food center and increase street food choices. This reported a development plan, not evidence that the project was completed.
history.quote: Develop into a modern food center and food court

timeline.title: Lan Long Market has food stalls open for service
timeline.detail: A review of Go Ek shop stated its location in Lan Long Market and recorded its opening hours from 11:00 to 17:00, serving as evidence of the area's use as a food market.

timeline.title: Municipality promotes Lan Long Market as a food hub
timeline.detail: Takua Pa Town Municipality recommended multiple food groups and stated the hours as 08:00 to 22:00. This evidence confirms the promotion in that year, not the market's founding year.

timeline.title: News on guidelines to upgrade the market into a modern food center
timeline.detail: News reported a guideline to develop it into a modern food center and food court, increasing street food choices, but it is not verified if the construction is completed.

news.title: Guideline to develop Lan Long Market into a modern food center
news.summary: News reported the market development plan and increased street food choices, while it is not verified if the construction is completed.

news.title: Coconut costs affect Hor Mok prices in Lan Long Market
news.summary: News cited an example of a Ton Pho Hor Mok vendor in Lan Long Market adjusting prices due to higher coconut costs.

news.title: Municipality invites eating at Lan Long Market
news.summary: Takua Pa Town Municipality published a video recommending the market and various types of food.

visit.parking: Wongnai states there is parking, but does not specify the number of spots, parking fees, or accessible parking for people with disabilities.
visit.opening_hours: 08:00 to 22:00 according to the Takua Pa Town Municipality video description published on 1 September 2024. The current schedule and holidays are not verified, and Wongnai lists another set of hours as every day 03:00 to 21:00.
visit.admission_fee: Wongnai states there is no admission fee for adults and children. There is still no confirmed evidence from the market management.
